description.zh:
查询报警历史的结束时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

> - 您只能查询最近一年的报警历史。
> - 开始时间（`StartTime`）和结束时间（`EndTime`）之间必须小于等于15天。
description.en:
The end timestamp of the alert logs to be queried.

Unit: milliseconds.

>

- You can query only the alert logs within the last year.

- The interval between the start time (`StartTime`) and end time (`EndTime`) must be less than or equal to 15 days.

description.zh:
告警类型。取值：

- TRIGGERED：告警触发。
- RESOLVED：告警恢复。
description.en:
The type of the alert event. Valid values:

- TRIGGERED: The alert is triggered.

- RESOLVED: The alert is resolved.

description.zh:
对数据进行空间维度聚合，相当于SQL中的Group By。取值：
- `product`：按照云服务统计。
- `level`：按照报警级别统计。
- `groupId`：按照应用分组统计。
- `contactGroup`：按照报警联系人组统计。
- `product,metricName`：按照云服务和监控项统计。
description.en:
The dimensions based on which data is aggregated. This parameter is equivalent to the GROUP BY clause in SQL. Valid values:

- `product`: aggregates data by cloud service.

- `level`: aggregates data by alert level.

- `groupId`: aggregates data by application group.

- `contactGroup`: aggregates data by alert contact group.

- `product,metricName`: aggregates data both by cloud service and by metric.
The ID of the application group.

description.zh: 获取日志的周期。单位：分钟。
description.en: The statistical period of alert logs. Unit: minutes.

description.zh:
报警的级别和通知方式。取值：

<props="china">- P2：电话+短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- P3：短信+邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="china">- OK：无报警。</props>

<props="intl">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="intl">- OK：无报警。</props>

<props="partner">- P4：邮件+钉钉机器人。</props>

<props="partner">- OK：无报警。</props>
description.en:
The severity level and notification methods of the alert. Valid values:

- P4: Alert notifications are sent by using emails and DingTalk chatbots.

- OK: No alert is generated.

description.zh:
监控项名称。

>关于云服务的监控项，请参见[云服务监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The metric name.

> For more information about the metrics of different cloud services, see [Appendix 1: Metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
云服务的命名空间。

>关于云服务的命名空间，请参见[云服务监控项](~~163515~~)。
description.en:
The namespace of the Alibaba Cloud service.

> For more information about the namespaces of different cloud services, see [Appendix 1: Metrics](~~163515~~).

description.zh:
每页显示记录条数。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Default value: 10.
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

description.zh:
报警规则ID。


关于如何获取报警规则ID，请参见[DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the alert rule.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an alert rule, see [DescribeMetricRuleList](~~114941~~).
The name of the alert rule.

description.zh: 查询报警历史的搜索关键字。
description.en: The keyword that is used to query alert logs.

description.zh:
报警状态。取值：
- 0：发生报警或报警恢复正常。
- 1：非生效期。
- 2：通道沉默周期。
- 3：主机重启中。
- 4：不发送报警。

<props="china">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P2、P3或P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
<props="intl">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
<props="partner">当报警状态为0时，如果Level的取值为P4，则发生告警；如果Level的取值为OK，则报警恢复正常。</props>
description.en:
The alert status. Valid values:

- 0: The alert is triggered or cleared.

- 1: The alert is ineffective.

- 2: The alert is muted and not triggered in a specified period.

- 3: The host is restarting.

- 4: No alert notification is sent.

If the value of the SendStatus parameter is 0, the value P4 of the Level parameter indicates a triggered alert and the value OK indicates a cleared alert.

description.zh: 该参数已废弃，无需关注。

查询报警历史的开始时间戳。

单位：毫秒。

> - 您只能查询最近一年的报警历史。
> - 开始时间（`StartTime`）和结束时间（`EndTime`）之间必须小于等于15天。
description.en:
The start timestamp of the alert logs to be queried.

Unit: milliseconds.

>

- You can query only the alert logs within the last year.

- The interval between the start time (`StartTime`) and end time (`EndTime`) must be less than or equal to 15 days.

title.zh: 查询报警历史的直方图列表

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，从云服务`product`维度查询ECS报警历史的直方图列表。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to query the number of alert logs for Elastic Compute Service (ECS) based on the `product` dimension.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-alert-log-histogram --start-time 1609988009694 --end-time 1609989009694 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-key alert --group-id 73010000 --product ECS --namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --level P4 --send-status 0 --contact-group ECS_Group --rule-name test123 --metric-name cpu_total --last-min 360 --group-by product --source-type '无' --event-type RESOLVED --rule-id ae06917_75a8c43178ab660000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeAlertLogHistogram --region cn-hangzhou --GroupBy product --EndTime 1609989009694 --PageSize 10 --EventType RESOLVED --SourceType '无' --RuleId ae06917_75a8c43178ab660000 --StartTime 1609988009694 --SendStatus 0 --Product ECS --Namespace acs_ecs_dashboard --GroupId 73010000 --MetricName cpu_total --PageNumber 1 --LastMin 360 --SearchKey alert --Level P4 --ContactGroup ECS_Group --RuleName test123
